verdict.rationale: For a laptop SoC, the sensible reading of a public API is its developer SDKs, and the axis applies. Qualcomm documents the AI Engine Direct SDK and AI Hub for deploying models to the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon X-series PCs. It also offers the open-source GenieX runtime and AI Hub's 'few lines of code' cloud profiling and inference on hosted devices. That is real programmatic access, but it covers only the AI/NPU slice, and the evidence is marketing-level rather than API reference docs. Missing for 10: API reference documentation specific to X2 Elite Extreme, programmatic control beyond AI model deployment, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDK/AI Hub APIs work on this chip.
